method: Read-only scan of enabled top-level JAR assets/data plus KubeJS same-path overlays. JAR path collision priority is deterministic filename order, not runtime evidence. No external or selected resource pack counted. CFPA all local versions, same namespace/document relative path; additionally GuideME /guides/{namespace}/guide/ to legacy /guide/ relocation candidate map. Exact comparison is full source document for Markdown/TXT, individual visible field for Patchouli; renamed paths not automatically inferred. Chinese presence is a candidate, not completeness proof. Documents and JSON fields are separate units. Language-backed manual keys are handled separately. Approximate words strip markup and code blocks. All candidates require term/context/format/license review.
